purpose: Document city-scope registry evidence and bounded public parcel-geometry route review.
assessment: The ministry-hosted Kantah Tulungagung portal exists; local government reporting confirms the office's PTSL/certificate work. No safe public cadastral feature route was verified.
registryAssessment: The official Indonesian ATR/BPN Tulungagung office portal is on the ministry's `atrbpn.go.id` domain. The official Tulungagung government reports joint local land-certificate/complete-systematic-registration (PTSL) work with Kantor Pertanahan/BPN Kabupaten Tulungagung and names the office head. This confirms a local land-registration authority, but no anonymous parcel geometry service or allowlisted geometry/ID schema was verified.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official ATR/BPN Tulungagung office subdomain; inspected page view exposed only the JavaScript-app shell, with no public geometry layer schema.
Official Tulungagung government report documents the local Kantor Pertanahan/BPN collaboration in PTSL land registration and certificate issuance and identifies the office head.
Official municipal SETUNGGAL one-map portal describes general geographic/spatial information, but no cadastral field schema was exposed.

Official municipal revenue portal describes PBB-P2 taxpayer services, requests NOP for lookup and contains taxpayer identity/account fields; it was inspected as a boundary only and no form/query was submitted.

accessReview.reason: The official Kantah subdomain returns only a JavaScript-app shell in the accessible page view. The municipality's Setunggal portal describes a general one-map geographic-information service, but no cadastral parcel schema was exposed in the inspected page. The official local PBB-P2 portal is a taxpayer-specific bill and record service: it requests an NOP and presents taxpayer name, account/payment details and requests NIK/name/address/phone for copies; no form was submitted and no tax record was queried. ATR/BPN BHUMI's generic help says its data catalog may include land parcels but does not establish Tulungagung coverage or expose a safe field allowlist. No parcel features were requested.

privacy: No owner, address, taxpayer, account, title, protected attribute, or property-record lookup was made. No geometry was retained.

runtimeAssessment.reason: City-specific land registration is established, but no public, TLS-protected parcel dataset with a documented geometry+stable-ID-only allowlist was located. The official municipal one-map and national BHUMI portals may contain other spatial layers, but the reviewed public descriptions do not establish a safe city parcel feature route. Taxpayer/account interfaces are excluded.
